svg.title: IoC and DI power socket metaphor
svg.desc: Visual metaphor: IPaymentProcessor is a wall socket standard. UPI, CreditCard, DebitCard are plugs that fit the socket. Checkout is the appliance that only knows it needs a socket. Main() is the person choosing which plug to insert.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why does Checkout only depend on the interface?')

svg.text: Checkout never calls new UPI() — it only knows the socket shape
swap any plug at any time without touching the appliance
